hero.srTitle: Amadewi Trans — private car and driver in Bali

slides.label: Private charter
slides.text: A private car, a local driver who knows the island by heart, and fuel for twelve full hours — all in one honest rate.
slides.alt: Pura Ulun Danu Beratan at sunrise

slides.label: Your driver
slides.text: Licensed and English-speaking. Knows which temple to reach before the tour buses — and which warung to stop at after.
slides.alt: An Amadewi driver beside a black Toyota Alphard

slides.label: Heritage route
slides.text: The morning Barong dance, stone carvers, Celuk silver and Tirta Empul — ten hours from our own front door.
slides.alt: A Barong mask during a Balinese dance performance

slides.label: Airport transfer
slides.text: Your name on a board at arrivals, cold water in the car, and a calm drive to your villa — whatever time you land.
slides.alt: The Balinese split gate at Ngurah Rai airport framing the runway

standard.title: One rate. <gold>Nothing</gold> hidden in the boot.
standard.text: Most rentals in Bali start cheap and end complicated. Ours starts complete: the car, the driver and the fuel are already in the price you see.

pillars.title: A driver, not just a driver
pillars.text: Licensed, English-speaking and born on the island. The kind of guide who knows which temple to reach before the tour buses, and where the good babi guling is.

pillars.title: Fuel is on us
pillars.text: Go from Seminyak to Sidemen and back. The tank is our problem, never a surprise line on your bill at the end of the day.

pillars.title: Twelve unhurried hours
pillars.text: From sunrise at the lake to sunset on the cliffs. Enough time to change your mind twice and still make dinner.

day.title: 06:30 to 18:30. <gold>Yours</gold> entirely.
day.text: Here's what twelve hours can look like. Keep it, change it or throw it away at lunch — your driver adapts.

stops.title: Pick-up at your door
stops.text: Cold water, charging cables and a plan waiting in the car.

stops.title: Lunch where drivers eat
stops.text: The warung that isn't on the list.

stops.title: A waterfall detour
stops.text: Because you asked, and there's time.

stops.title: Sunset on the cliffs
stops.text: Parked, cooled and ready when you are.

stops.title: Home, unhurried
stops.text: Same smile at the door as at dawn.

items.quote: Our driver was so knowledgeable about Bali and took us to incredible places we never would have found on our own.

items.quote: Perfect for families! The 12-hour service gave us plenty of time to explore multiple temples and enjoy lunch at scenic spots.

items.quote: Great value for money! Having gasoline included made budgeting so much easier. Highly recommend Amadewi Trans!
items.name: Emma Wilson

home.title: Born in the village of <gold>moonstone.</gold>
home.text: Batubulan means “moon stone”. It's the village in Sukawati where Bali's temple guardians are carved by hand and where the Barong dance is performed every morning. It's also where every Amadewi car starts its day — central to Ubud, Sanur and everything you came for.
